svg.title: 568-70.9001 connections between cabinet, console and machine (thread t5, redrawn 2026, not an original document)
svg.text: Adast Maxima MS 115 PS, wiring set 568-70.9001: connections between the cabinet, the console and the machine
Redrawn 2026 by thread t5 from netlist/merged_cores.csv and merged_wires.csv (not an original document): one line per core that leaves the cabinet, grouped by cable bundle.
Abbreviations: PE (protective earth); PLC (programmable logic controller) with its inputs IN-x and outputs OUT-x; Ø (diameter); mm (millimetres). Wire numbers as printed; ⏚ = earth.
B1 (cable bundle 1): 25 cores, cabinet to the console, the lamps on the console front and, over branch B5, the clamp beam
legs used: B1, B1-E1, B1-E2, B1-E3, B1-E4, B5, B5-Y14, B5-S28, B5-S28s, B5-S28r, B5-S28p, B1-T, B1-PLC
trunk B1: Ø 20 mm, 2991.5 mm long, estimated ±100 mm; B5: Ø 16 mm, 2279 mm long, estimated ±200 mm
B3 (cable bundle 3): 13 cores, feed motor and blower connectors to the backgauge feed motor and the air cushion
legs used: B3, B3-XC3, B3-M3, B3-Y3
trunk B3: Ø 20 mm, 4548.5 mm long, estimated ±200 mm
Inside the cabinet: connector pins that no cable leaves through
cabinet wiring of the connectors service socket XC7, inverter speed setpoint XC50 and the encoder connector's shell
control-system connector, inverter speed setpoint; plc_drive: sure; power: estimated ±1 column
control-system connector, inverter speed setpoint; plc_drive: sure; power: estimated ±1 column
service socket 230 V (110 V); power: sure
service socket 230 V (110 V); power: sure
service socket 230 V (110 V); power: sure
B2 (cable bundle 2): 15 cores, table-cabinet connector and encoder connector to the front table and the backgauge
legs used: B2, B2-R, B2-S24, B2-F, B2-S11, B2-XC4
trunk B2: Ø 24 mm, 3014 mm long, estimated ±200 mm
B4 (cable bundle 4): 37 cores, terminal strip in the cabinet to the main drive, the knife and the hydraulics
legs used: B4, B4-R, B4-K, B4-Y01, B4-Y11, B4-S19, B4-Y10, B4-SQ1, B4-SQ2, B4-S13, B4-S14
trunk B4: Ø 24 mm, 6354 mm long, estimated ±200 mm
on the machine: from the knife sensors' terminal strip X8 to the sensors (leg B4-K and its branches)
line = the core's evidence mark in merged_cores.csv; red = on the on-site list measure_list.md
Left: wire number as printed (grey), the cabinet wiring of a connector pin, the terminal or pin where the core leaves the cabinet. Middle: the bundle legs of scheme_3d/bundles.csv it runs through.
Right: the far terminal and its device. Routes are estimated (unseen legs ±200 mm); the 3D (three-dimensional) routes are in viewer/index.html.
Not drawn: 2 rows of merged_cores.csv (power 37, control 185), the same conductor as a drawn core or a superseded line; see netlist/merged_conflicts.csv.

Not drawn either: 13 machine wires (thread and line of its wires file) whose two ends sit at one item of the 3D scheme (a suppressor at its magnet, a bridge inside one device, X8 at S12), so no bundle carries them; length [?]:
control 89 Y01 + -> V01 1; control 90 V01 2 -> Y01 -; control 95 Y14 + -> V14 1; control 96 V14 2 -> Y14 -; control 103 Y11 1 -> RC11 1
control 104 RC11 2 -> Y11 2; control 118 Y10 + -> V10 1; control 119 V10 2 -> R10 1; control 120 R10 2 -> Y10 -; control 148 S10 3A -> S10 1A
control 158 S11 3A -> S11 1A; control 173 X8 4 -> S12 2; control 174 S12 1 -> X8 1
